props.description: The inscription reads: Dawn rings before Noon; Dusk answers last.

props.name: Rings mechanism
props.description: Align the rings from left to right: Dusk, Dawn, Noon.

props.name: Stars mechanism
props.description: Select the two lights that border Noon: Dawn and Dusk.

illusions.name: Marble wall
illusions.description: Your fingers pass through cold marble. The painted wall is a veil over an open passage.

illusions.name: Painted doorway
illusions.description: A careful touch finds stone behind the painted doorway.

illusions.name: An impossible statue
illusions.description: The statue is light cast on empty air.

puzzles.name: Bells mechanism
puzzles.clue: The inscription reads: Dawn rings before Noon; Dusk answers last.
puzzles.incorrect: The mechanism clicks incorrectly and clears the input. Read the inscription again.
puzzles.success: The mechanism chimes. Its pattern is solved. The marble veil fades, revealing the passage.
puzzles.reset: The mechanism clears. You may start again.
